properties.title: New Property
properties.description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘆
This stunning, newly built home offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and tropical living. Thoughtfully designed for families who value space, privacy, and quality, the property sits within a quiet, secure neighborhood just minutes from Zanzibar's main airport — making it ideal for both permanent residents and frequent travelers.

𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗙𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝘀
𝗘𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁 & 𝗦𝗽𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝗟𝗮𝘆𝗼𝘂𝘁
The home is designed to maximize every square meter. With two large master bedrooms — one featuring a Jacuzzi and the other an English-style bathtub — plus a third well-sized bedroom, the layout comfortably accommodates families of all sizes. A guest bathroom is conveniently located between the living and dining area, ensuring guests are always well catered for.

𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗿𝗻 𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗲𝘀 & 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
Built to high standards, this property showcases quality craftsmanship throughout. The big open kitchen is perfect for modern living, while the four full bathrooms reflect a commitment to comfort and convenience rarely found at this price point.

𝗦𝗲𝗹𝗳-𝗦𝘂𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱
Beyond the main house, the compound includes a fully equipped external kitchen, a maid's room, a storeroom, a laundry room, and an additional bathroom — offering the kind of functionality that makes daily life effortless.

𝗡𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗟𝗶𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗲 & 𝗚𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝗦𝘂𝗿𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀
The compound features a beautiful garden and a small productive farm with apple (Matufaha), fig, avocado, papaya, banana, chilli, and lemongrass trees. A true farm-to-table lifestyle, right at home.

𝗣𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
Located only a 3-minute drive or 5-minute walk from Zanzibar International Airport, this property offers exceptional connectivity without sacrificing peace and quiet.

𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗣𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗮𝗹
With Zanzibar's real estate market growing steadily and demand for quality housing rising, this property represents strong long-term value — whether as a primary residence or a rental investment.


𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
𝗦𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 & 𝗜𝗻𝗳𝗿𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲
The neighborhood surrounding this property is known for its safety and stability. With no recorded crimes in the area, residents enjoy genuine peace of mind. The roads are accessible, utilities are well-established, and the overall infrastructure supports comfortable, hassle-free living.

𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗔𝘁𝗺𝗼𝘀𝗽𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲
This is a warm, welcoming community where neighbors know each other and a genuine sense of belonging thrives. It is the kind of environment where children play freely and families feel truly at home — a rarity that is becoming increasingly valued in today's fast-moving world.

𝗦𝗵𝗼𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗴 & 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘃𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲
Essential day-to-day needs are easily met, with local markets, shops, and retail options within close reach of the property. Zanzibar Town's broader shopping scene, including supermarkets, hardware stores, and specialty shops, is also easily accessible by car.

𝗗𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 & 𝗘𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
From local Zanzibari cuisine to international dining experiences, the surrounding area and nearby Zanzibar Town offer a growing variety of restaurants, cafés, and eateries. Whether you prefer a casual meal with the family or a special evening out, options are never far away.

𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹𝘀 & 𝗘𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀
Families with school-age children will appreciate the proximity to reputable educational institutions in Zanzibar, including international and government schools offering quality education at various levels. The airport location also makes access to mainland Tanzania and international destinations straightforward for families with broader educational needs.

𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 & 𝗢𝘂𝘁𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗿 𝗟𝗶𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗲
Zanzibar's natural beauty is part of everyday life here. Pristine beaches, nature trails, water sports, and cultural heritage sites are all within reach. The property's own garden and farm also offer a tranquil, outdoor lifestyle right at home — perfect for unwinding after a long day.

𝗔 𝗕𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗱 𝗨𝗿𝗯𝗮𝗻 & 𝗜𝘀𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗟𝗶𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗲
This home offers the best of both worlds: the convenience of being close to the city and the airport, combined with the calm, green surroundings of a residential neighborhood. It is a lifestyle that balances productivity with relaxation — and that balance is increasingly hard to find.

𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗟𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴
Owning a home in Zanzibar is more than a financial decision — it is a commitment to a higher quality of life. With Zanzibar's growing economy, expanding tourism sector, and rising demand for quality residential properties, this home offers not only a place to live but a sound long-term asset. Whether you are buying for your family or as part of an investment portfolio, this property delivers real, lasting value.

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻
This is more than just a house — it is a home built for the way modern families want to live. Spacious, secure, green, and superbly located, it offers everything you need to settle in and thrive in beautiful Zanzibar.
Keys are available. Book your visit today and let our representative guide you through the property personally.

articles.title: Complete Guide to Buying Land in Zanzibar
articles.excerpt: Buying land in Zanzibar is a great opportunity for both local buyers and foreign investors. Zanzibar offers strong ...
articles.content:
Buying land in Zanzibar is a great opportunity for both local buyers and foreign investors. Zanzibar offers strong economic growth, beautiful landscapes, and a growing real estate market.

Whether you are looking for beachfront property, agricultural land, or urban plots, Zanzibar has a wide variety of options. The process of buying land involves working with the Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority (ZIPA) and the Ministry of Land.

articles.title: How ZIPA Approval Works for Foreign Property Investors
articles.excerpt: Zanzibar is one of the most attractive destinations for foreign property investors. Its growing tourism industry, s ...
articles.content:
Zanzibar is one of the most attractive destinations for foreign property investors. The Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority (ZIPA) is the government body that facilitates and regulates foreign investment on the island.

To invest in real estate as a foreigner, you must obtain a Certificate of Incentives from ZIPA.
